body: Reaction height invalidation is thin: chatListRowSignatureFields (ios/ChatModule/ChatListViewModels.swift:1754) carries ONLY ('reactionEmoji', row.reactionEmoji), which is derived as reactions.first?.emoji (:1028). So nil→first emoji flips the signature, but count changes, isSelected changes, and adding/removing a SECOND emoji do not — and those change the strip's width and (on wrap) its height. chatListRowContentEqual (:1666) does compare the full lhs.reactions array, so the CELL reconfigures while the cached height in liveHeightStore does not: that is the 'chip overlaps the text, then the cell height jumps' sequence. Fix = append a reactions component to chatListRowSignatureFields (APPEND ONLY — chatListRowSignatureFlippedFieldNames diffs positionally against persisted arrays) and bump the height-formula revision in ChatListView.swift:~1031.
